reader.zh-Hant: DOMSkeletonXrayTool 會抓取目標頁 HTML，剔除文字、圖片、腳本與噪音區塊，只保留具有 id/class/data-* 的結構骨架，並提供高頻 selector 建議。
reader.en: DOMSkeletonXrayTool fetches target HTML, strips text/images/scripts/noise blocks, preserves structural tags with id/class/data-* attributes, and returns high-frequency selector hints.
reader.ja: DOMSkeletonXrayTool は対象HTMLを取得し、テキスト・画像・スクリプト等を除去して id/class/data-* 属性を持つ構造骨格のみを保持し、頻出セレクタ候補を返します。

symbols.name: DOMSkeletonXrayTool
symbols.summary: Create a compressed DOM skeleton from a full web page for parser design.

tool_contract.name: dom_skeleton_xray
tool_contract.description: Fetch and compress an HTML page into a structural skeleton while preserving key attributes.

methods.name: execute
methods.signature: execute(target_url: str, render_dynamic: bool = False, dynamic_wait_ms: int = 1500, save_policy: str = 'inline', output_target: str = 'memory', output_path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]
methods.summary: Returns JSON including skeleton_html, key_selectors, and render stats; supports file-routing payload.

examples.title: Extract structural skeleton from a page

runtime_notes.content: Nodes are kept when they carry id/class/data-* attributes or are required to preserve child structure.
Skeleton output is truncated by max_skeleton_chars to avoid oversized tool responses.
Supports save_policy/output_target/output_path so heavy skeleton output can be persisted to file.
